release.name: Blossom
release.author: Izumi
release.description: A phone-first Material You look in soft pink over violet-black, with very round corners, a mesh glow and Nunito. The bottom bar is a centred floating pill with a tonal highlight behind the active tab; the trending pager fills pink bars at the end; section titles are uppercase; the series page switches between Info and Watch through a bar of two equal tabs, with chips for score, format, episodes and season. Desktop keeps the palette with a wider banner.
